name: silversync
description: SilverSync - Elderly Care & Medication Management Platform

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix client run test

scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
